title: Union Minister promises all support to farmers hit by cyclones in Andhra Pradesh

content: TDP wins 2,571 of 3,897 wards for which poll results have been declared, while YSRCP secures 550 wards, JSP emerges victorious in 484 wards, and BJP grabs 153 wards; counting for Chirala municipality postponed to November 6

title: India thrash South Korea 8-1 to storm into ACT final, set up Japan clash
content: India delivered a stunning display of skill, overpowering South Korea 8-1 in the Asian Champions Trophy semi-final. With Shilanand Lakra and Dilpreet Singh each netting two goals and Harmanpreet Singh converting a key penalty corner, the team regained control after an early goal from their opponents. The momentum carried through the second quarter, as India continued to surge, setting up a final showdown against Japan.

title: Agniveers get 2-year extension, higher pay: Key changes under scheme explained
content: With Diwali approaching, nearly 20,000 Agniveers will have the opportunity to serve for two more years. The Union Cabinet's decision follows the initial batch nearing the end of its four-year service term. As many as 75% of Agniveers were scheduled to leave the armed forces. The revised scheme allows these personnel to gain further experience before being considered for permanent roles.

title: How Florida turned toy rabbits into robots to lure pythons & protect Everglades
content: Florida researchers created robotic rabbits to attract invasive Burmese pythons in the Everglades. These decoys imitate real prey by moving and generating heat, aiding in detection. The project employs remote monitoring to facilitate python removal by the South Florida Water Management District. Traditional methods relied on live rabbits, which posed logistics challenges, making robotic alternatives more practical. Current testing continues with future plans to add scent to enhance effectiveness.

title: Unfazed by Emerging Teams Asia Cup snub, Priyansh Arya vows to keep pushing
content: Despite missing out on the Emerging Teams Asia Cup, Priyansh Arya remains unfazed, determined to keep pushing for opportunities. The Delhi batter discusses his explosive white-ball game, competition with Abhishek Sharma and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, his red-ball growth and his ambition to keep knocking on the door of India selection.

title: Texas couple lost home in 2001, took reverse mortgage in 2011; court revives case
content: A Texas appeals court has reopened a lengthy dispute over home ownership in Houston, which has complicated legal issues. The case involves multiple foreclosures, reverse mortgages, and unclear ownership claims spanning twenty-five years. Key questions remain about the validity of a 2011 mortgage after a previous foreclosure occurred in 2001. This ruling requires lower courts to thoroughly examine competing ownership claims before making decisions.

title: H-1B, immigration and Trump: Why Indian-American voters turned away from Republicans
content: With Democrats gaining Congressional control, Indian-Americans are grappling with uncertainty regarding immigration rules and job opportunities. Heightened fears about H-1B visa restrictions and deportation have taken center stage. In addition, increasing discrimination and the prevailing political climate are altering feelings of identity among the community. New survey data reveals a trend towards favoring Democratic candidates, indicating that the outcomes of the midterms might significantly influence the Indian-American experience.

title: 'Accepted with great excitement': Nadal's journey from Real Madrid fan to boardroom
content: Rafael Nadal has been offered a position on Real Madrid's Board of Directors and has accepted the proposal. This appointment will be submitted for ratification by the club's General Assembly of Delegate Members. Nadal expressed his gratitude and excitement about contributing to the club's future. He remains active in public engagements following his retirement from professional tennis.

title: Texas teen died in car fire; parents' foundation awards $67,000 to 67 people
content: Tragedy struck when 18-year-old student Kenli Riney died in a highway accident in Texas, with the Argote family making valiant attempts to save her. To commemorate her spirit, they founded the Kenli Foundation, which offers scholarships to young individuals showing courage and kindness. Additionally, they introduced the Argote Award Scholarship to recognize and reward the remarkable bravery of those who come to the aid of others.

title: Zac Brown's Georgia camp farm feeds children, supports veterans and families
content: Founded by Zac Brown in 2011, Camp Southern Ground is a beacon of inclusivity for children and veterans. Spanning 400 acres, its campus includes an organic farm that not only provides nutritious meals but also offers educational initiatives. Over the years, Camp Southern Ground has evolved to enhance support for military families, using a rounded approach that fosters personal growth through food, outdoor activities, and community engagement.

title: Why Texas turning Blue is Elon Musk’s ‘biggest defeat’
content: Billionaire Elon Musk made waves by investing heavily in Republican candidates during the Texas elections, yet the results fell short of expectations. His funding strategy sought to offset the potential Democratic surge and influence Senate dynamics. Nevertheless, the Democrats emerged victorious in key positions, signaling a transformative shift in Texas politics. This pattern of billionaire losses highlights a growing uncertainty for Republican reliance on Texas as a steadfast voter base.

title: Bengaluru couple's Rs 60,000 rent and Rs 75,000 travel bill spark debate
content: Living in Bengaluru, a local couple's monthly financial outlay reaches about Rs 1.73 lakh, revealing stark economic differences in the city. Their budget includes Rs 60,000 for rent and Rs 75,000 for travel, showcasing a prioritization of experiences and wellness through high-protein groceries. This financial scenario starkly contrasts with entry-level IT employees' earnings, which often fall considerably short of the couple's expenditure.

title: Owaisi urges UP Muslims to strengthen political identity after El-Sayed’s Michigan win
content: In a rallying cry, Asaduddin Owaisi urged the Muslim community in Uttar Pradesh to embrace and amplify their political identity following Abdul El-Sayed's groundbreaking Senate victory. This election marks a pivotal moment, as El-Sayed becomes the first Muslim to occupy a Senate seat in the US, sending ripples across India. Owaisi's comments illuminate the ongoing quest for robust political representation among Muslims in the region.

title: 'One match doesn't decide a career': Anshul Kamboj's strong response to critics
content: Anshul Kamboj made a significant impact in India's ODI against New Zealand, skillfully taking two wickets and aiding in restricting the opponent to a modest score of 185. His disciplined bowling, emphasised through consistent lengths and a wobble seam delivery, was crucial. With contributions from Virat Kohli and Shubman Gill, India clinched the win by achieving the revised target.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion makeover hits another roadblock
content: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion project faces fresh opposition as neighbours raise concerns about potential damage to a century-old sewer line from planned landscaping. Despite spending $7,500 on repairs and revising fence plans, Kelce’s team has encountered another setback. Local officials approved some landscaping but rejected shoreline tree plans, asking for further revisions before granting approval.

title: Diwali rush, GRAP curbs bring Delhi to a crawl: Long jams leave commuters fuming
content: Delhi is facing significant traffic congestion as festive shopping intensifies ahead of Diwali. Reports indicate long queues of vehicles and gridlocked roads across various locations. Commuters are expressing frustration over insufficient traffic management and enforcement of parking rules. Major intersections and market areas are particularly affected, with delays frequently lasting over 30 minutes. Authorities are urged to enhance the deployment of traffic personnel to alleviate congestion.

title: 'Normalise, recognise, formalise': Nadda says Cong opposing SIR to help outsiders
content: Union health minister JP Nadda accused the Congress party of opposing the Special Intensive Revision of voter lists. He alleged that their actions are aimed at protecting outsiders who support their political ambitions. Nadda criticized the Congress for undermining the credibility of the Election Commission when faced with electoral losses. He noted that the current electoral process includes Booth Level Officers facilitating voter registration door-to-door.

title: US midterm election results 2026: Top 10 winners and losers
content: The 2026 midterm elections ushered in an unprecedented Democratic surge, shaking the foundations of traditional Republican strongholds. With both chambers of Congress now under Democratic control, candidates like Abdul El-Sayed highlighted a vital increase in Muslim representation in U.S. politics. This election cycle also signified a setback for Donald Trump, challenging his political dynamics as he navigates a Congress that is decidedly unfriendly towards him.

title: US midterms: Red alert for Republicans as Democrats notch stunning flips
content: The 2026 US midterm elections saw a significant turnaround for the Democrats, who successfully overturned several Republican-held positions. They secured a vital Senate seat in North Carolina and won the governorship in Georgia. Gains in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Kentucky, and Iowa underscored a shift in political dynamics, with Roy Cooper and Annie Andrews emerging victorious in their Senate races. These outcomes herald a challenging phase for Trump's party.

title: WPL schedule announced: Vadodara, Mumbai to host 5th edition; RCB vs MI in opener
content: The Board of Control for Cricket in India has officially unveiled the schedule for the eagerly awaited fifth edition of the Women's Premier League. Kicking off on January 14, 2027, the tournament will take place across the vibrant cities of Vadodara and Mumbai. Defending champions Royal Challengers Bengaluru will clash with the Mumbai Indians in the opening match.

title: 'He was annoying': Jacob Duffy's hilarious take on Virat Kohli after India's win
content: Jacob Duffy shed light on Virat Kohli's remarkable display during India's decisive five-wicket triumph over New Zealand in an ODI match. Scoring 74 runs off 51 balls, Kohli showcased his class against a struggling New Zealand side, which could only muster 180 runs. Duffy commended India’s bowlers for their efficient control, which made scoring notably tough, and recognised New Zealand's tenacious yet insufficiently aggressive play.

title: ‘Habibi, call me Senator’: Abdul El-Sayed mocks Trump, Vance in victory speech
content: Abdul El-Sayed won the Michigan Senate race against Republican Mike Rogers, marking a significant milestone in history. His victory speech included pointed remarks aimed at both Vice President JD Vance and former President Trump. El-Sayed's campaign focused on progressive issues such as universal healthcare and criticized outside influence in elections. The election was closely contested, with substantial spending from various interest groups.

title: PV Sindhu back in world top six after four years; how she scripted her comeback
content: PV Sindhu has ascended to the world No. 6 ranking in women's singles, her best position since December 2022. Her recent triumph at the Hylo Open in Germany, which marks her second title this season, showcases her impressive consistency. Notably, Sindhu is set to participate in the BWF World Tour Finals in Hangzhou, China.

title: Bengaluru techie who threatened Ayushmann, Tusshar in Bishnoi gang's name arrested
content: In a shocking turn of events, Mumbai Police have apprehended Vaibhav Mishra for transmitting threatening audio messages to various Bollywood stars. Posing as a member of the notorious Lawrence Bishnoi gang, he targeted high-profile celebrities, including Ayushmann Khurrana and Tusshar Kapoor. This unsettling incident followed a frightening shooting attack on Tiger Shroff, which the gang readily acknowledged, inciting widespread fear within the film industry.

title: Sachin Tendulkar's record gone! Virat Kohli creates history during India's NZ chase
content: During the rain-affected first ODI against New Zealand at Eden Park, Virat Kohli achieved remarkable feats, overtaking Sachin Tendulkar's long-standing record of 8,720 runs in chases. He mirrored Ricky Ponting's tally of 1,971 runs against New Zealand and became the first player to hit 13,000 runs batting at number three in ODIs. Kohli's stellar performance highlighted his consistent excellence, driving India to a celebrated victory.

title: Blue trumps Red: 10 key takeaways from US midterm elections
content: In a surprising twist during the 2026 US midterm elections, the Democrats regained control of Congress, managing to flip a number of Republican-held districts. Candidates endorsed by Trump faced unexpected defeats in what were once viewed as secure territories. Economic turmoil and the escalating situation in Iran played crucial roles in shaping voter decisions.

title: 'Rohit bhai's run-out changed the momentum': Gill on turning point in India's win
content: In a thrilling ODI, Shubman Gill lauded Rohit Sharma for his pivotal run-out of Daryl Mitchell, which turned the tide in India's favor. The bowlers, led by Arshdeep Singh's four-wicket haul, effectively limited New Zealand to 185 runs. Virat Kohli's 74 runs were instrumental in chasing the revised target, despite rain disruptions. India triumphed with a five-wicket win, taking a 1-0 series lead.

title: Historic 1st in US midterms: Black, Indigenous, Latina & LGBTQ leaders win key races
content: The 2026 US midterm elections have led to historic firsts in gubernatorial and Senate races across the nation. Notable victories include the first Black woman governor in US history and the first Native American woman governor. The election of Texas' first Latina governor and Florida's first Black governor also signify progress in representation. Additionally, Minnesota has elected its first woman governor, further enhancing diversity in leadership roles.

title: Kohli's 74, Arshdeep's 4-wicket haul guide India to victory against New Zealand
content: In an exhilarating start to the ODI series, Virat Kohli's innings of 74 runs propelled India to a crucial five-wicket win over New Zealand. Despite rain interruptions, India's pace attack, spearheaded by Arshdeep Singh's four wickets, limited New Zealand to 185. Kohli paired brilliantly with Shubman Gill, guiding India efficiently through the revised target under Duckworth-Lewis-Stern. This victory marks India's lead in the five-match series.

title: PV Sindhu sees new wave in Indian badminton: 'Now we have these girls'
content: PV Sindhu is back in the world's top six after winning the HYLO Open, her second BWF World Tour title of 2026. As she targets another climb, Sindhu welcomes the emergence of young Indian shuttlers Tanvi Sharma, Ashmita Chaliha, Anmol Kharb and Unnati Hooda. She also discusses managing her tournament schedule, the challenge posed by An Se-young and the changes coming with badminton's 15-point format.

title: Midterm blues: Why 'lame' duck Donald may push for a quick India-US trade deal
content: The unfavourable midterm election outcome is unlikely to prompt President Donald Trump to change course on trade, according to an analysis by Global Trade Research Initiative (GTRI). Trump is now likely to use his executive authority to push India towards an early agreement that opens up the Indian market to American agricultural and industrial products, while securing other significant concessions for US businesses.

title: Zelenskyy honours Melania Trump for helping secure ceasefire in Russian-occupied Oleshky
content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy awarded Melania Trump the Order of Princess Olga for her humanitarian work. She was instrumental in organizing a humanitarian evacuation from the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky. An important ceasefire allowed nearly 800 residents to access emergency supplies and evacuate safely. Melania Trump is hosting representatives from both Russia and Ukraine to discuss the ceasefire efforts.

title: High Court Rejects Giribala Singh's Bail In Twisha Sharma Death Case
content: The plea was rejected by a single bench of Justice Ajay Kumar Nirankari after the completion of arguments by defence and prosecution counsels on October 26.

title: At Punjab Rally, Rahul Gandhi Remembers Sidhu Moosewala, Then Attacks AAP
content: Rahul Gandhi, who formally launched the Congress campaign in Punjab, recalled his meeting with the singer before his entry into the Congress and said he had seen a dynamic and talented young man who wanted to contribute to Punjab and the country.

content: The change in the Agnipath scheme is being deemed a big shift in policy as it gives a longer rope to aspirants who want to prolong their service in the armed forces.

content: In 2022, the BJP was a marginal player. Today it has a higher vote share than SAD, urban momentum, a set of AAP defectors with local standing, and a plausible path to rural reinforcement through SAD.

content: This follows Indian carriers IndiGo, Air India Group and Akasa Air already agreeing to move services.

title: Who Is Pia Dandiya? Indian-Origin Democrat Who Won Florida Seat In US Midterms
content: Pia Dandiya said she entered politics to help more families get better opportunities and live a better life.

title: In Recruitment Body Row, Kerala Chief Minister Questions Opposition, Ex Governor
content: VD Satheesan said former governor RV Arlekar recommended the removal of Kerala Public Service Commission Chairman MR Baiju to the President without consulting the state government.

title: 'Threats Continue': Aaftab Poonawala's Lawyer Complains To Court Again
content: Aaftab Poonawala's lawyer submitted that no action has been taken by the jail authorities despite the court's earlier directions.

title: Opinion: Opinion | Trump's Midterm Rout Has One More Victim: JD Vance
content: Vance campaigned as hard as the President, served as the Republican National Committee's finance chair. He watched his home state of Ohio elect a Democratic governor and send a Democrat to the Senate seat he gave up to become Vice President.

title: 4 Militants Killed As Rival Naga Groups Clash In Manipur Village
content: Police sources said three of the dead belonged to the Zeliangrong United Front (Jenchui faction), or ZUF(J), and one to the National Socialist Council of Nagalim (NSCN-IM). The clash took place at Taodaizing village on Wednesday.

content: Left with no support, the woman is now living on the streets with her four children, forced to beg to feed the family.

title: Explained: Donald Trump's Veto Powers And How He Can Use Them
content: US President Donald Trump has described his presidential veto as his “ultimate power” and indicated that he could use it to block legislation passed by Democrats.

title: Dialling Wrong Number, Maybe You Should Protest: Chief Justice On Quota Plea
content: The court was hearing a petition seeking mandatory rotation of constituencies reserved for SCs and STs in state Assemblies.

content: In its letter dated November 3, the traders' body expressed concern over the financial losses suffered by businesses due to frequent demonstrations and traffic disruptions over the past month.

title: French blood plasma storage hit by hackers in widening cyberattack campaign

title: 'U-turn out of fear': Cong links Centre's Agniveer move to upcoming assembly polls

title: ‘You could smell alcohol on his breath’: Rahul targets Bhagwant Mann over drug menace
content: Rahul Gandhi slammed the chief minister for failing to tackle the state's drug problem . he also accused the aam aadmi party of being controlled by leaders in Delhi . the CM clarified that drinking was a personal choice .

title: Iran exempts Indian vessels from Hormuz curbs, citing medicine imports
content: the latest exemption comes amid heightened concern over the safety of Indian nationals working aboard vessels in the Gulf . the death toll from attacks on merchant shipping has risen to 23 . india, china, Iraq and Qatar have been granted exemptions and their vessels could pass through the strategic waterway without restrictions .

title: 'Walked into room with tattoos': Rahul recalls first meeting with Sidhu Moosewala

content: the president sees red over his party’s defeat, with Democrats sweeping both the House and Senate . governments around the world are watching warily, weighing how the shift in congressional power could reshape Washington’s foreign policy .

title: Donald the 'lame' duck: Trump loses House & Senate, but can he be stopped?
content: the phrase has become a major part of Indian politics with parties using it to one up each other in the ever lasting loop of the electoral cycle . but for the 45th & 47th POTUS, the phrase may signal things to come . a majority for the Dems in both the House and the Senate .

title: Sharad Pawar hospitalised again, hours after discharge
content: pawar was admitted to Breach Candy Hospital on friday . the veteran leader was discharged earlier in the day . he was admitted for a general check-up and medical observation following complaints of pleuritic pain .

title: 'Dialled wrong number': CJI's 'dharna' quip at man seeking rotation of SC-ST seats
content: a bench of cJI Surya Kant and justices rejects his plea for mandatory rotation of seats reserved for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in parliament and state assemblies . the supreme court says the petitioner is free to approach public representatives and persuade them to adopt the principle of rotation .

title: Republicans trumped, stumped, and dumped as Dems win both House and Senate
content: Democrats swept both chambers of Congress, taking control of the house and Senate . the rout of the Republicans is a political bloodbath of epic proportions . voters hand him and his MAGA-infused Republican Party an electoral pink slip .

title: Trump loses US Congress; Netanyahu faces deadlock at home: What happens to Iran war now?
content: two political setbacks and one unresolved war for both leaders . both leaders face growing pressure at home even as conflict remains unresolute . u.s. strikes on Iranian targets near the Strait of Hormuz came just hours before amess .

title: SC rejects woman's plea to terminate six-month pregnancy over marital discord
content: the woman's husband opposed the termination, arguing that he too had a right over the unborn child and was willing to take care of the baby after birth . the case came before a bench of justices who expressed concern over the request .
